subject: Stratagem AI POC — request for trial extension, free credits, and commit discount
messages:
From: Eva Torres <eva@stratagem.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-02-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: POC: request for extended trial + credits

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the streaming latencies you showed are promising. Our engineering team wants to extend the POC by an extra 6 weeks and make sure we have headroom while we validate prompts. Two asks from our side: a) a two-month trial extension (we're currently at the end of month one), and b) a one-time bucket of free inference credits (roughly 500k tokens) so we can run longer prompt sweeps without exhausting the trial.

Separately, if we commit to a 6-month paid ramp after the POC, would Redwood consider a volume discount (we estimate ~1M tokens/month initially)? Our procurement asks for any standard commit discounts you have.

Appreciate the help — can you outline what you can approve vs what needs exec sign-off?

Best,
Eva Torres
Product Lead, Stratagem AI
[Attachment: Stratagem_POC_note.txt (text)]

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Eva Torres <eva@stratagem.ai>
Date: 2029-02-10T12:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC: request for extended trial + credits

Hi Eva — great to hear the demo resonated. I can do the extension on the trial on our side (no problem) and provide a preliminary credit bucket, but anything above our standard trial allotment and any commercial discount for a committed term will need manager/exec approval.

Immediate next steps I propose:
- I will extend your trial window by 60 days (pending internal approval confirmation).
- I'll escalate the 500k-token credit and the 6-month commit discount to my manager (Marissa) and finance for an exception.
- If helpful, I can put together a simple MAP and a pricing sketch to speed approvals.

Can you confirm the 1M tokens/month estimate and if the 6-month commit is firm? If yes I’ll include a proposed credit + discount structure in the escalation.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

The 6-month commitment is likely but we have to see dev velocity. For procurement, they want any available percentage off list for a 6-month pre-paid or monthly-commit billing.

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2029-02-11T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Stratagem AI — escalation: credit + commit discount request

Marissa / Grace — forwarding the request from Stratagem (see thread below). Quick summary:
- Customer: Stratagem AI (early-stage, strong technical buy-in).
- Asks: 60-day trial extension + 500k-token one-time credit to cover prompt sweeps.
- Commercial: If they sign a 6-month commit (estimate ~1M tokens/month), they want a commit discount.
- Our recommendation: approve 250k one-time credit + authorize a commit discount range to offer (15–25% depending on prepaid vs monthly).

Attached are a short MAP and a back-of-envelope pricing calc for a 6-month ramp.

Attachments: [Stratagem_Mutual_Action_Plan_v2.pdf (pdf)], [pricing_calc_20290211.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

Can you review and advise on exec approval? If you want finance in the thread I can add them — this is time-sensitive, they want the extension and credits to unblock tests this week.

Thanks,
Dylan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-02-11T12:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Stratagem AI — escalation: credit + commit discount request

Thanks for the concise summary, Dylan. A few clarifying Qs before sign-off:
1) Is Stratagem a net-new account or switching from another provider? (impacts churn risk)
2) Can we require the credit to be used only during the trial window (i.e., expire at end of extension)?
3) What is the expected ARR if they convert at the 1M tokens/month estimate?

Proposed approval scope (prelim):
- One-time credit: 250k tokens (to be consumed during extended trial only).
- Trial extension: 60 days.
- Commit discount: 20% on consumption for a 6-month committed plan, subject to signed MSA and finance confirmation of payment terms.
- Condition: credit does not apply against committed minimums and is forfeited if no signed agreement within 45 days of trial end.

If finance confirms the ARR math and risk is acceptable (net-new, low churn probability), I will approve the above. If they truly need 500k credits, require a revenue-based trade (e.g., partial prepaid).

Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial (Sales Ops)
Redwood Inference

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-02-11T13:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Stratagem AI — escalation: credit + commit discount request

Marissa — thanks. Quick answers below and attached a short ARR/commit table:
1) Net-new account (no prior vendor).
2) Yes — we can gate the credit to the extended trial period; that is how we typically handle trial top-ups.
3) ARR estimate: at 1M tokens/month x conservative $0.0006/token blended = ~$720/month gross margin is TBD, implies ~$4,320 ARR (this is a simplified number; see attached calc for tiered price scenarios).

Attached: [pricing_calc_20290211.xlsx (spreadsheet)], [MAP_summary.docx (docx)]

Given the ARR is modest initially, I recommend approving the 250k token credit + 20% for a 6-month commit (with prepayment option for 25% off). If they insist on 500k tokens, propose 250k credit + 250k contingent on 50% prepayment of month 1–3.

If you approve, I’ll send the formal MAP and a signed-off term sheet to Stragagem and open the DocuSign.

Dylan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>

Subject: Approval: Stratagem AI credit + commit discount (conditions)

Approved with conditions:
- Approve 250k token one-time credit to be used only during the 60-day trial extension.
- Approve 20% discount on consumption for a 6-month commit (25% if customer prepays months 1–3).
- Credit explicitly does not count toward committed minimums.
- Customer must sign MSA and counterparty payment terms within 45 days after trial end, or the credit is forfeited.
- Finance to confirm invoicing cadence; Grace please confirm offline if the revenue recognition approach is acceptable.

Dylan, proceed to send the MAP and the term sheet to the customer and include the DocuSign link. Document the concession in HubSpot (deal id DEAL-7831).

Marissa Cole
